text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- It is still uncertain whether Hungary would join a multinational peace-keeping force in Albania.
- Hungary, Poland and the Czech Republic will be invited to join NATO at the Madrid summit in July, Reuters news agency said.

- Entrepreneurs must pay social security contribution for the first four months of the year according to the rules approved by parliament as the Constitutional Court is not likely to make its decision on these rules soon.
- The Government Supervisory Office (KEI) will submit to the government in one month its proposal about the introduction of obligatory declarations of property.
